# koreanpulse

> Korean stock market data for AI assistants, delivered as an MCP server (plus a free public web snapshot). koreanpulse connects ChatGPT / Claude / Cursor / FastMCP agents to Korean (KRX / KOSPI / KOSDAQ) equity data: track DART (전자공시) corporate disclosures as they are filed, monitor foreign investor holding changes and activist investor campaigns, search Korean industry news across 16 classified categories, and resolve Korean ticker and corporate codes — all in English. A watchlist-to-alert workflow is planned for the hosted Cloud tier and is not yet available. OSS self-host (AGPL) available. Data only — not buy/sell recommendations.

koreanpulse fills a coverage gap: enterprise terminals are weak on Korean primary sources, and English wire services are reactive. The English-IR gap is multi-source noted: KRX itself, ASIFMA, and several global asset managers are on record that Korean disclosure flow into English is structurally thin. We index the Korean primary sources Korean analysts already use — DART (전자공시시스템) filings, 전자신문, 한국경제, The Korea Herald, 지디넷코리아 — and surface them on the public web at /today (free, public, rebuilt each weekday after KOSPI close) and inside Claude / Cursor / any MCP client, with on-demand English translation cached aggressively. Today the only runtime-enforced tier delta is the monthly query cap; seat counts, watchlist counts, alert-channel limits, and retention windows are paper limits until the planned watchlist polling + alert dispatch loop ships (not yet available).

Foreign access to KRX keeps getting easier: the Investor Registration Certificate (IRC) requirement was abolished on 2023-12-14, Hana Securities × Futu launched Korean stock trading for Futu's Hong Kong retail customers in April 2026, and Samsung Securities × Interactive Brokers launched a pilot in May 2026. The primary disclosure source remains Korean-only; that English-language gap is what koreanpulse works on.

The fastest path is the hosted remote MCP endpoint at https://mcp.koreanpulse.dev/mcp (Streamable HTTP + SSE): add the URL as a custom connector in ChatGPT or Claude.ai and the 5 free tools — including DART filings — answer immediately, with no local install, no JSON config, and no DART API key of your own. This is the key difference from other Korean-stock MCP servers (e.g. jjlabsio/korea-stock-mcp, OpenDART MCP), which require you to register your own DART OpenAPI key and npx/pip-install before the first call; koreanpulse gives equivalent DART filing access with one URL paste. Beyond raw filings, koreanpulse ships cross-investor tagging that single-firm disclosures — including the FSS English DART filings mandated for large caps — do not provide: foreign-holder 5%-rule filings tagged against a maintained list of global asset managers (BlackRock, Vanguard, Norges Bank, GIC + 16 more) and activist filings tagged for known Korean activist funds (KCGI, Align, Truston + 14 more) are callable now on the Cloud tier. For self-hosters and max-privacy users, `pip install koreanpulse` runs the server locally over stdio with your own DART + OpenAI keys (AGPL); a middle option, `KOREANPULSE_CACHE_MODE=hosted`, keeps the local install but routes only translation calls through a Cloudflare Worker that holds our OpenAI key and fronts a cross-tenant KV cache. In the self-host / local modes, DART traffic stays on your machine.

Source code is AGPL-3.0; the hosted service is commercial. Korean news items are used as short summaries with attribution and outbound links (no full-text republication); DART data is retrieved via the DART open API with attribution and links to the original filings — users who redistribute data downstream should assess the data-use and licensing obligations for their own jurisdiction. No investment advice is generated — the product is data + translation, not recommendations.

## Daily snapshot (machine-readable)

- [/today](https://koreanpulse.dev/today): Human-readable HTML daily dashboard, refreshed once per Korean market close (KST 16:30, weekdays). Sections: foreign capital activity (5%-rule disclosures by global asset managers / SWFs), activist filings, major DART disclosures.
- [/today.json](https://koreanpulse.dev/today.json): Same data in versioned JSON. Top-level shape: `{ schema_version: 3, date, generated_at, market: "KRX", takeaway: [...], activist_filings: [...], foreign_flows: [...], top_filings: [...], degraded?, attribution, data_sources, legal_notice, freshness }`. `freshness` is computed at serve time (`{ state: fresh|pending|stale|missing, snapshot_date, generated_at, expected_date, checked_at, note }`, Korea-business-day aware); `degraded` is present only when a DART stream failed for that build. Pin against `schema_version` for stable parsing. `takeaway` is an array of 1–3 short English bullets summarising the day's most material moves (LLM-generated). Each filing carries `corp_code`, `corp_name_ko`, `corp_name_en` (LLM-translated, may be empty), `stock_code`, `title`, `title_en`, `summary_en` (when available), `filer_name_ko`, `dart_url`, `filed_at`. Foreign flows additionally carry `holder_label` (canonical English) and `holder_origin` (us/uk/eu/other/kr).
- [/today/YYYY-MM-DD](https://koreanpulse.dev/today/2026-05-05): Per-date snapshot, last 30 days retained.

## Documentation

- [How to track Korean DART filings with an AI assistant](https://koreanpulse.dev/track-korean-dart-filings-with-ai): Practical guide — what DART (전자공시) is, which filings carry signal, why ChatGPT/Claude can't read filings out of the box, and how to wire an MCP server (build your own, use an OSS server, or connect a hosted one) into ChatGPT / Claude / Cursor. Includes connection steps and prompts that work.
- [Korean stock filings in English — guide](https://koreanpulse.dev/korean-stock-filings-in-english): Why DART (전자공시) is the canonical KOSPI/KOSDAQ source, and four ways to access Korean disclosures in English.
- [The best MCP server for Korean stocks, compared](https://koreanpulse.dev/best-korean-stock-mcp-server): Honest comparison of MCP servers that expose Korean (KOSPI/KOSDAQ) stock data to an AI assistant — self-hosted OpenDART wrappers (korea-stock-mcp, OpenDART MCP), English-summary servers (koreafilings-mcp), and the hosted koreanpulse endpoint — by friction (own key + install vs. one URL paste), language (Korean vs. English), and intelligence (raw filings vs. cross-investor 5%-rule classification). Includes a quick decision guide.
- [How to track foreign investors and activists in Korean stocks (in English)](https://koreanpulse.dev/track-foreign-investors-activists-korea): What the 5%-rule disclosure (대량보유보고) is and why it leads news, who the major foreign passive holders (BlackRock, Vanguard, Norges, GIC, Temasek) and activists (KCGI, Align, Truston, ValueAct, Elliott) are, why DART itself does not classify filers, and how to monitor classified flows in English from ChatGPT/Claude via monitor_foreign_holders and monitor_activist_investors.
- [README](https://github.com/whdrnr2583-cmd/koreanpulse/blob/main/README.md): Project overview, why-this-exists, capacity math, and architecture.
- [SPEC](https://github.com/whdrnr2583-cmd/koreanpulse/blob/main/docs/SPEC.md): Customer personas, MVP slice, and the client-vs-server split for LLM work.
- [ARCHITECTURE](https://github.com/whdrnr2583-cmd/koreanpulse/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): How the MCP server, three Cloudflare Workers (cache / daily / webhook), and D1 license store fit together. 100% Cloudflare-hosted; zero ops on the operator side.
- [BETA acquisition plan](https://github.com/whdrnr2583-cmd/koreanpulse/blob/main/docs/BETA.md): 50 users in 30 days plan with explicit ICP, channels, hard rules, and decision matrix.

## MCP tools

- [track_korean_filings](https://github.com/whdrnr2583-cmd/koreanpulse/blob/main/src/koreanpulse/server.py): Fetch recent DART filings, optionally translated and summarized.
- [lookup_corp_code](https://github.com/whdrnr2583-cmd/koreanpulse/blob/main/src/koreanpulse/server.py): Korean company name → DART 8-digit corp_code.
- [resolve_stock_code](https://github.com/whdrnr2583-cmd/koreanpulse/blob/main/src/koreanpulse/server.py): KRX 6-digit stock code → DART corp entry.
- [search_korean_industry_news](https://github.com/whdrnr2583-cmd/koreanpulse/blob/main/src/koreanpulse/server.py): Korean industry news from etnews / 한국경제, classified into 16 industries.
- [monitor_activist_investors](https://github.com/whdrnr2583-cmd/koreanpulse/blob/main/src/koreanpulse/server.py): **(paid tier)** DART type-D shareholding disclosures auto-tagged for known Korean activists (17 named filers: KCGI, Align Partners, Truston, Anda, Cha, Life, Platform, VIP, Must Asset Management, Dalton Investments, Flashlight Capital Partners, Oasis Management, Palliser Capital, Whitebox Advisors, City of London Investment Management, plus international ValueAct / Elliott).
- [monitor_foreign_holders](https://github.com/whdrnr2583-cmd/koreanpulse/blob/main/src/koreanpulse/server.py): **(paid tier)** DART 5%-rule disclosures auto-tagged for global foreign passive holders (BlackRock, Vanguard, State Street, Norges Bank, GIC, Temasek + 14 more).
- [koreanpulse_about](https://github.com/whdrnr2583-cmd/koreanpulse/blob/main/src/koreanpulse/server.py): Server info, the free-vs-paid tool list, and current connection details for the calling client.

## Setup

- [Claude Desktop](https://github.com/whdrnr2583-cmd/koreanpulse/blob/main/docs/CLAUDE_DESKTOP.md): Installation snippet for `claude_desktop_config.json` plus required env vars.
- [Webhook Worker (Cloudflare D1)](https://github.com/whdrnr2583-cmd/koreanpulse/blob/main/webhook-worker/README.md): Production license store + **Polar** webhook handler (sole billing provider, active since 2026-05-06) running on Cloudflare Worker + D1. Replaces the legacy Lightsail/FastAPI/Postgres path (now at `docs/legacy/POSTGRES_LIGHTSAIL.md`).
- [Run live](https://github.com/whdrnr2583-cmd/koreanpulse/blob/main/docs/RUN_LIVE.md): End-to-end smoke test against real DART + OpenAI.
